title: ChatVTG: Video Temporal Grounding via Chat with Video Dialogue Large Language Models

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: Comparison between previous methods based on Video LLMs and our approach: Previous methods require fully supervised training of the Video LLM, whereas our method does not require training and can provide temporal grounding zero-shot.

problems.name: Annotation Scarcity and Noisy Supervision
problems.evidence_sentence: To address these challenges, we present ChatVTG, a novel approach that utilizes Video Dialogue Large Language Models (LLMs) for zero-shot video temporal grounding.

problems.name: Domain Shift and Generalization
problems.evidence_sentence: To address these challenges, we present ChatVTG, a novel approach that utilizes Video Dialogue Large Language Models (LLMs) for zero-shot video temporal grounding.

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: Existing VTG methods largely depend on supervised learning and extensive annotated data, which is labor-intensive and prone to human biases.

methods.name: LLM Reasoning, Agentic Workflows, or RL Post-Training
methods.evidence_sentence: Comparison between previous methods based on Video LLMs and our approach: Previous methods require fully supervised training of the Video LLM, whereas our method does not require training and can provide temporal grounding zero-shot.

methods.name: Coarse-to-Fine or Hierarchical Localization
methods.evidence_sentence: To further refine the temporal boundaries, we conduct moment refinement by generating additional moment proposals using a sliding window approach.

methods.name: Transformer/DETR-Style Proposal Decoding
methods.evidence_sentence: 1, different from existing methods that utilize VTG data to train Video LLMs for temporal grounding capabilities, our approach combines captions and matching to find the moment without training the Video LLM.
